title: Chapter 14 — Psittaciformes
description: An order of intelligent, highly social birds renowned for their vocal learning ability, strong zygodactyl feet, and curved beaks. Parrots are found across tropical and subtropical regions worldwide, with the greatest diversity in South America and Australasia. Many species are long-lived and form strong pair bonds, and several are among the most endangered bird groups due to habitat loss and the pet trade.

children.name: Amazona diadema
children.description: The diademed amazon (Amazona diadema) is a parrot in the family Psittacidae formerly considered conspecific with the red-lored amazon (Amazona autumnalis).

children.name: Amazona farinosa
children.description: The mealy amazon or mealy parrot (Amazona farinosa) is among the largest parrots in the genus Amazona, the amazon parrots.

children.name: Amazona festiva
children.description: The festive amazon (Amazona festiva), also known as the festive parrot, is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Amazona leucocephala
children.description: The Cuban amazon (Amazona leucocephala), also known as the Cuban parrot and the rose-throated parrot, is a medium-sized mainly green parrot found in woodlands and dry forests of Cuba, the Bahamas and Cayman Islands in the Caribbean.

children.name: Amazona ventralis
children.description: The Hispaniolan parrot (Amazona ventralis), also known as Hispaniolan amazon, is a species of psittaciform bird of the family Psittacidae endemic to Hispaniola, which includes the Dominican Republic and Haiti.

children.name: Amazona xantholora
children.description: The Yucatan amazon (Amazona xantholora), also known as the yellow-lored amazon, Yucatan parrot or yellow-lored parrot is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Anodorhynchus hyacinthinus
children.description: The hyacinth macaw (Anodorhynchus hyacinthinus), or hyacinthine macaw, is a parrot native to central and eastern South America.

children.name: Ara macao
children.description: The scarlet macaw (Ara macao) also called the red-and-yellow macaw, red-and-blue macaw or red-breasted macaw, is a large yellow, green, red and blue Neotropical parrot native to humid evergreen forests of the Americas.

children.name: Ara militaris
children.description: The military macaw (Ara militaris) is a medium to large-sized macaw, named after its green and red plumage vaguely resembling a military uniform.

children.name: Aratinga nenday
children.description: The nanday parakeet (Aratinga nenday), also known as the black-hooded parakeet or nanday conure, is a medium-small, mostly green, Neotropical parrot native to continental South America.

children.name: Aratinga solstitialis
children.description: The sun conure (Aratinga solstitialis), also known as the sun parakeet, is a medium-sized, vibrantly colored parrot native to northeastern South America.

children.name: Bolborhynchus lineola
children.description: The barred parakeet (Bolborhynchus lineola), also known as the lineolated parakeet (commonly nicknamed the "linnie") or the Catherine parakeet, is a small psittaciforme bird found in the highland forests of tropical Latin America.

children.name: Bolborhynchus orbygnesius
children.description: The Andean parakeet (Bolborhynchus orbygnesius) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Brotogeris sanctithomae
children.description: The tui parakeet (Brotogeris sanctithomae) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Brotogeris tirica
children.description: The plain parakeet (Brotogeris tirica) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Cyanoliseus patagonus
children.description: The burrowing parrot, also known as the burrowing parakeet or the Patagonian conure, is a species of parrot native to Argentina and Chile. It belongs to the monotypic genus Cyanoliseus, with four subspecies that are currently recognized.

children.name: Enicognathus ferrugineus
children.description: The austral parakeet, austral conure, cachaña, rawilma or emerald parakeet (Enicognathus ferrugineus) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Eupsittula cactorum
children.description: The Caatinga parakeet (Eupsittula cactorum), also called the cactus parakeet and in aviculture the cactus conure, is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Eupsittula canicularis
children.description: Eupsittula canicularis, also known as the orange-fronted parakeet, orange-fronted conure, half-moon conure or Petz's conure is a vulnerable species of birds in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Forpus coelestis
children.description: The Pacific parrotlet (Forpus coelestis), also known as Lesson's parrotlet, or the celestial parrotlet, is a species of small parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Forpus conspicillatus
children.description: The spectacled parrotlet (Forpus conspicillatus) is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Forpus crassirostris
children.description: The riparian parrotlet (Forpus crassirostris) or large-billed parrotlet is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Forpus cyanopygius
children.description: The Mexican parrotlet (Forpus cyanopygius), also known as the turquoise-rumped parrotlet or the Mexican blue-rumped parrotlet, is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Guaruba guarouba
children.description: The golden parakeet, golden conure, or Queen of Bavaria conure (Guaruba guarouba) is a medium-sized golden-yellow Neotropical parrot native to the Amazon Basin of interior northern Brazil.

children.name: Myiopsitta luchsi
children.description: The cliff parakeet (Myiopsitta luchsi) is a Near Threatened species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Myiopsitta monachus
children.description: The monk parakeet (Myiopsitta monachus), also known as the monk parrot or Quaker parrot, is a species of true parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Nannopsittaca dachilleae
children.description: The Manu parrotlet (Nannopsittaca dachilleae) or Amazonian parrotlet is a species of parrotlet native to the western Amazon basin, from southern Peru to northwest Bolivia.

children.name: Nannopsittaca panychlora
children.description: The tepui parrotlet (Nannopsittaca panychlora) is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Pionopsitta pileata
children.description: The South American pileated parrot (Pionopsitta pileata) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Pionus fuscus
children.description: The dusky parrot (Pionus fuscus) or dusky pionus is a medium-sized mainly dark brownish-gray parrot of the genus Pionus in the true parrot family.

children.name: Poicephalus robustus
children.description: The Cape parrot (Poicephalus robustus) or Levaillant's parrot is a large, temperate forest dwelling parrot of the genus Poicephalus endemic to South Africa.

children.name: Poicephalus senegalus
children.description: The Senegal parrot (Poicephalus senegalus) is a parrot which is a resident breeder across a wide range of west Africa.

children.name: Psilopsiagon aurifrons
children.description: |range_map = Psilopsiagon aurifrons map.svg.

children.name: Psittacara brevipes
children.description: The Socorro parakeet (Psittacara brevipes), known in aviculture as the Socorro green conure or Socorro conure , is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Psittacara chloropterus
children.description: The Hispaniolan parakeet (Psittacara chloropterus) is a Vulnerable species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Psittacara euops
children.description: The Cuban parakeet (Psittacara euops) is a Vulnerable species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Psittacara frontatus
children.description: The cordilleran parakeet (Psittacara frontatus) is a Near Threatened species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Psittacara holochlorus
children.description: The green parakeet (Psittacara holochlorus), green conure, or Mexican green conure is a New World parrot.

children.name: Psittacara mitratus
children.description: The mitred parakeet (Psittacara mitratus), also known as the mitred conure in aviculture, is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Psittacara rubritorquis
children.description: The green parakeet (Psittacara holochlorus), green conure, or Mexican green conure is a New World parrot.

children.name: Psittacara strenuus
children.description: The Pacific parakeet (Psittacara strenuus), known as Pacific conure or Nicaraguan green conure in aviculture , is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Psittacus erithacus
children.description: The grey parrot (Psittacus erithacus), also known as the Congo grey parrot, is an African parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Psittacus timneh
children.description: The Timneh parrot (Psittacus timneh), also known as the Timneh grey parrot or Timneh African grey parrot, is a West African parrot.

children.name: Pyrilia aurantiocephala
children.description: The bald parrot (Pyrilia aurantiocephala) or orange-headed parrot is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Pyrilia caica
children.description: The caica parrot (Pyrilia caica) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Pyrilia vulturina
children.description: The vulturine parrot (Pyrilia vulturina) is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Pyrrhura amazonum
children.description: The Santarém parakeet (Pyrrhura amazonum), also known as Hellmayr's parakeet or in aviculture as Hellmayr's conure or the Santarém conure, is a species of parrot in the family Psittacidae.

children.name: Pyrrhura emma
children.description: The Venezuelan parakeet (Pyrrhura emma) or Emma's conure is a species of bird in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Pyrrhura lepida
children.description: The pearly parakeet (Pyrrhura lepida), known as the pearly conure in aviculture, is a Vulnerable species in subfamily Arinae of the family Psittacidae, the African and New World parrots.

children.name: Pyrrhura picta
children.description: Perruche à gorge tachetée, de Cayenne.

children.name: Psephotellus
children.description: Psephotellus — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Psephotellus chrysopterygius
children.description: The golden-shouldered parrot, also known as the alwal, arrmorral, minpin, thaku, or antbed parrot, is a rare bird of the southern Cape York Peninsula, in Queensland, Australia. A small parrot related to the more common hooded parrot (P. dissimilis) of the Northern Territory and the extinct paradise parrot of Queensland and New South Wales.

children.name: Psephotellus dissimilis
children.description: The hooded parrot is a species of parrot native to the Northern Territory in Australia. It is found in savannah and open woodland and is one of two extant species in its genus that breed in termite mounds. It has declined from much of its original range.

children.name: Psephotellus pulcherrimus
children.description: The paradise parrot is an extinct species of colourful medium-sized parrot native to the grassy woodlands extending across the Queensland and New South Wales border area of eastern Australia. Once moderately common within its fairly restricted range, it became extinct in 1927.

children.name: Psephotellus varius
children.description: The mulga parrot is endemic to arid scrublands and lightly timbered grasslands in the interior of southern Australia. The male mulga parrot is multicolored, from which the older common name of many-coloured parrot is derived.

children.name: Lophopsittacus
children.description: Lophopsittacus — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Lophopsittacus mauritianus
children.description: The broad-billed parrot or raven parrot is a large extinct parrot in the family Psittaculidae. It was endemic to the Mascarene island of Mauritius. The species was first referred to as the "Indian raven" in Dutch ships' journals from 1598 onwards.

children.name: Parvipsitta
children.description: Parvipsitta — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Parvipsitta porphyrocephala
children.description: The purple-crowned lorikeet, is a lorikeet found in scrub and mallee of southern Australia. It is a small lorikeet distinguished by a purple crown, an orange forehead and ear-coverts, and a light blue chin and chest.

children.name: Parvipsitta pusilla
children.description: The little lorikeet is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae. It is endemic to Australia. It is a small parrot, predominantly green in plumage with a red face.

children.name: Necropsittacus
children.description: Necropsittacus — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Necropsittacus rodricanus
children.description: The Rodrigues parrot or Leguat's parrot is an extinct species of parrot that was endemic to the Mascarene island of Rodrigues. The species is known from subfossil bones and from mentions in contemporary accounts. It is unclear to which other species it is most closely related, but it is classified as a member of the tribe Psittaculini, along with other Mascarene parrots.

children.name: Synorhacma
children.description: Synorhacma — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Synorhacma multistriata
children.description: The striated lorikeet is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae native to New Guinea. It was formerly the only species placed in the genus Synorhacma. It is threatened by habitat loss.

children.name: Saudareos
children.description: Saudareos — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Saudareos flavoviridis
children.description: The Sula lorikeet is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae. It is endemic to the Sula Islands in Indonesia. It is found in forest and woodland at altitudes up to 2,400 m (7,900 ft).

children.name: Saudareos iris
children.description: The iris lorikeet (Trichoglossus iris) is a small, up to long, green lorikeet bird.

children.name: Saudareos johnstoniae
children.description: The Mindanao lorikeet or Mount Apo lorikeet is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae. It is only found in the Philippines on the island of Mindanao. Its natural habitat is tropical moist montane forests.

children.name: Saudareos ornata
children.description: The ornate lorikeet (Trichoglossus ornatus), sometimes named the ornate lory, is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Hypocharmosyna
children.description: Hypocharmosyna — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Charmosynoides
children.description: Charmosynoides — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Charmosynoides margarethae
children.description: The duchess lorikeet (Vini margarethae) is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Charminetta
children.description: Charminetta — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Charminetta wilhelminae
children.description: The pygmy lorikeet (Charminetta wilhelminae) is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Charmosynopsis
children.description: Charmosynopsis — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Charmosynopsis pulchella
children.description: The fairy lorikeet (Charmosynopsis pulchella) is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Glossoptilus
children.description: Glossoptilus — a genus of old world parrots in the family Psittaculidae.

children.name: Cacatua
children.description: White cockatoos — medium to large parrots with white plumage and prominent erectile crests. Found across Australia, New Guinea, and Indonesia. Highly intelligent and social, they form large, noisy flocks. Their powerful bills can crack the hardest seeds and nuts. Several species are popular in aviculture.

children.name: Cacatua goffiniana
children.description: The Tanimbar corella (Cacatua goffiniana), also known as Goffin's cockatoo or Tanimbar cockatoo, is a species of cockatoo endemic to forests of Yamdena, Larat, and Selaru, all islands in the Tanimbar Islands archipelago in Indonesia.

children.name: Cacatua ocularis
children.description: A white cockatoo with blue eye-ring from the Bismarck Archipelago.

children.name: Cacatua sanguinea
children.description: The little corella (Cacatua sanguinea), also known as the short-billed corella, bare-eyed cockatoo, blood-stained cockatoo, and little cockatoo is a white cockatoo native to Australia and southern New Guinea.

children.name: Cacatua pastinator
children.description: The western corella (Cacatua pastinator) also known as the western long-billed corella, is a species of white cockatoo endemic to south-western Australia.

children.name: Callocephalon
children.description: The gang-gang cockatoo — a monotypic genus endemic to southeastern Australia. The male is unmistakable with its wispy, forward-curving crimson crest that resembles a feathery toupee. The species has a distinctive creaking call like a rusty gate.

children.name: Calyptorhynchus
children.description: Large black cockatoos with red or yellow tail panels from Australia.

children.name: Eolophus
children.description: The galah — a monotypic genus containing one of Australia's most familiar and abundant cockatoos. Distinctive pink-and-grey plumage makes it unmistakable. Highly social, forming large flocks that can number thousands.

children.name: Lophochroa
children.description: Lophochroa — a genus of cockatoos in the family Cacatuidae.

children.name: Lophochroa leadbeateri
children.description: The pink cockatoo, also known as Major Mitchell's cockatoo or Leadbeater's cockatoo, is a medium-sized cockatoo that inhabits arid and semiarid inland areas across Australia, with the exception of the north-east.

children.name: Nymphicus
children.description: The cockatiel — a monotypic genus and the smallest member of the cockatoo family. Separated from the true cockatoos by its long tail and more slender build. One of the most popular pet birds worldwide, renowned for its whistling ability and gentle temperament.

children.name: Probosciger
children.description: A large black cockatoo with red cheek and massive bill.

children.name: Probosciger ater
children.description: A large black cockatoo with red cheek patches and massive bill from Cape York and New Guinea.

children.name: Zanda
children.description: Zanda — a genus of cockatoos in the family Cacatuidae.

children.name: Zanda baudinii
children.description: Baudin's black cockatoo, also known as Baudin's cockatoo or the long-billed black cockatoo, is a species of genus Zanda found in southwest Australia. The epithet commemorates the French explorer Nicolas Baudin. It has a short crest on the top of its head, and the plumage is mostly greyish black.

children.name: Zanda funerea
children.description: The yellow-tailed black cockatoo is a large cockatoo native to the south-east of Australia measuring 55–65 cm (22–26 in) in length. It has a short crest on the top of its head. Its plumage is mostly brownish black and it has prominent yellow cheek patches and a yellow tail band.

children.name: Zanda latirostris
children.description: Carnaby's black cockatoo, also known as the short-billed black cockatoo, is a large black cockatoo endemic to southwest Australia. It was described in 1948 by naturalist Ivan Carnaby. Measuring 53–58 cm (21–23 in) in length, it has a short crest on the top of its head.
